HARDENING.purpose: adversarially close or delay currently live reduction doors to manufacture harder states and expose alternate collapse routes
examples: minimum joint debt covers used as experimental hardening

SOLVER.purpose: apply certified reductions that preserve SAT with explicit reconstruction and strictly reduce a progress measure or terminate
examples: BVE with exact resolvents and reconstruction
RUP strengthening with independently replayed UP conflict
UNIT/PURE/SUBSUMPTION where their existing certificates apply

outer_counterexample_preregistration.candidate_solver_stack: frozen certified R33 primary stack + micro one-RUP-then-restart bridge + affine terminal where already certified

counterexample_classes.condition: a selected solver move cannot be independently certified
a SAT-preserving/equisatisfiable reduction has a model of the reduced formula that cannot be reconstructed to a model of the source formula
an accepted nonterminal move fails the preregistered strict polynomial progress measure
the certified primary stack stalls, the allowed micro RUP bridge cannot reopen progress, and no already-certified terminal class applies
the metered candidate solver exceeds its explicit polynomial envelope on the tested outer instance
validation detects SAT/UNSAT disagreement between the certified solver outcome and an independent oracle on instances small enough for oracle validation

outer_counterexample_preregistration.success_condition_for_future_outer_gate: every tested outer instance either terminates through a certified solver door or is emitted as an explicit proof-carrying counterexample class above
